description: GitHub GraphQL error types. GitHub reports an error's code as a top-level `type` (moved to `extensions.code` by src/graphql-transport.ts). These types apply throughout the graph: any node lookup can miss, and any field can be forbidden to the token.

value.description: The node, or something the query refers to, does not exist or the token cannot see it.
The token lacks the permission the field or mutation requires.
GitHub refused the mutation for the object's current state, e.g. a draft transition on a closed pull request.
The token's GraphQL rate limit is exhausted.
GitHub failed to resolve the query.
